$comment: Which resource fixes which problem, at what cost and with what prerequisites. Like topology.json: these are facts, not orders. Nothing here says what to do first — that is the agent's call.

remedies.effect: Restores grid power to EVERYTHING hanging off the repaired node. The highest coverage per resource spent.
remedies.$note: A generator is no substitute: a substation is not powered, it is repaired. It is slow, but it is the only action that returns the grid to every dependent at once.

remedies.effect: Local supply for as long as the fuel lasts. Does not fix the cause, buys time.
remedies.$note: Occupies the resource while connected: it cannot be split between two sites.

remedies.effect: Refills the site's tank or the connected generator: +8 h of autonomy.
remedies.$note: With no load and no station to refill at, the tanker stops being useful.

remedies.effect: Directs the junction by hand and returns travel times to normal for every resource.
remedies.$note: Saves nobody on its own. It is what lets every other resource arrive in time.
